verse.verse_3: And by the even and the odd.
verse.verse_4: And by the night when it departs.
verse.verse_5: Is there (not) in them sufficient proofs for men of understanding!
verse.verse_6: Saw you not how your Lord dealt with `Ad
verse.verse_8: The like of which were not created in the land
verse.verse_9: And Thamud, who hewed out rocks in the valley
verse.verse_11: Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands.
verse.verse_13: So, your Lord poured on them different kinds of severe torment.
verse.verse_14: Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful.
verse.verse_15: As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honor and bounties, then he says: "My Lord has honored me."
verse.verse_16: But when He tries him by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"
verse.verse_17: But no! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity!
verse.verse_18: And urge not one another on the feeding of the Miskin!
verse.verse_19: And you devour the Turath -- devouring with greed.
verse.verse_20: And you love wealth with love Jamma.
verse.verse_21: Nay! When the earth is flatened, Dakkan Dakka.
verse.verse_22: And your Lord comes with the angels in rows.
verse.verse_23: And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance avail him
verse.verse_24: He will say: "Alas! Would that I had sent forth for my life!"
verse.verse_25: So on that Day none will punish as He will punish.
verse.verse_26: And none will bind as He will bind.
verse.verse_28: "Come back to your Lord, -- well-pleased and well-pleasing!"
